Its micro-cap ($9.2K) and volatile price action (180% spikes) have drawn degenerate traders and meme coin communities, fueled by low liquidity ($4K) and high volatility. The token’s rapid spread mirrors speculative meme coin dynamics, amplified by crypto Twitter snipers tracking its charts and top holder clustering (22% supply concentrated). Its appeal lies in Robinhood’s retail-friendly branding and leveraged trading narratives, attracting high-risk gamblers. Community-shared charts and real-time metrics drive FOMO, though its sustainability hinges on broader adoption beyond pump cycles.
